upcomingEvents.title: SACRA Annual Anesthesia Research Symposium
upcomingEvents.speaker: Keynote: SACRA Executive Committee & Student Presenters
upcomingEvents.description: Our flagship research event featuring student abstract presentations, clinical breakout panels, and a discussion on anesthesia safety improvements and evidence-based practices at Kibogora Polytechnic. Registration includes a certificate of attendance.

upcomingEvents.title: Clinical Simulation Workshop: Crisis Resource Management
upcomingEvents.location: Kibogora Polytechnic Clinical Skills Lab, Rusizi Campus
upcomingEvents.speaker: Eric Ndahimana (Director of Education) & Clinical Training Staff
upcomingEvents.description: An interactive, hands-on crisis simulation workshop focusing on perioperative emergencies, team-based communication, and resuscitation protocols. Seats are strictly limited to 20 students.

upcomingEvents.title: Introduction to Systematic Reviews in Anesthesia
upcomingEvents.speaker: Mbabazi Clemantine (Director of Research) & SACRA Research Team
upcomingEvents.description: A comprehensive introductory webinar detailing how to formulate search strategies, register protocols, screen abstracts, and perform risk-of-bias assessments for anesthesia studies. Open to all SACRA members.

pastEvents.title: Anesthesia Safety Checklist Training — Rusizi District Clinics
pastEvents.summary: SACRA members conducted hands-on WHO Safe Surgery Checklist training sessions with health workers at local primary care clinics in Rusizi District, promoting standardized pre-procedure verification.

pastEvents.title: Kibogora Polytechnic Health Awareness Day
pastEvents.summary: A campus-wide health awareness event organized by SACRA covering Non-Communicable Diseases (NCDs), hygiene promotion, emergency response awareness, and anesthesia-related patient safety education.

pastEvents.title: Pediatric Sedation Protocols & Patient Outreach Campaign
pastEvents.summary: Educational drive educating local health clinics on safe sedation guidelines and monitoring checklists for pediatric patients, conducted by SACRA members in collaboration with clinical staff.
